headline: FBI Accuses North Korea of Stealing Over $6 Billion in Binance Cyberattack
summary: The FBI formally accused North Korean hackers of stealing more than $6 billion from cryptocurrency exchange Binance, confirming previous assessments by security researchers.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume, and state-sponsored security breaches highlight ongoing operational risks across the digital asset industry.

impacts.name: Binance
impacts.why: The exchange was identified as the victim of a major state-sponsored crypto theft exceeding $6 billion.
